candidates.description: This vector activates for common French language characters, linguistic affixes, and determiners.
This feature vector activates on common Thai prepositional and relational prefixes, suffixes, and functional root morphemes.
This feature vector represents the Thai consonant letter 'ค' (kho khwai) and its common occurrences at the beginning of syllables or combined with various Thai vowel and tone marks.
This vector represents common Thai modal verbs, auxiliary verbs, and frequent pronouns used to indicate future action, possibility, or necessity.
This vector is related to a sequence of consecutive integers.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant 'ส' (So Suea) appearing as a suffix or within various Thai words and syllables.
These tokens represent variations and common prefixes of Thai consonant and vowel combinations, often functioning as phonetic building blocks or text fragments in Thai script.
This feature vector activates on Thai script characters and sub-word tokens containing Thai consonants and vowels.
This vector represents non-English script fragments and diacritics associated with multilingual subword tokenization.
This feature vector activates on common French words and grammatical articles.
